about: Polyvoid: three levels (the Hollow Square, the Hex Warden, the Gauntlet of both) chosen on the title; bosses that evolve (one square -> four -> four with orbiting orbs; a hex that unfolds spikes), bullets, sweeping and wide lasers; an orbiting hero whose laser fires by itself and grows with grazes; almost no UI (score, lives, two rings, a life arc round each boss); music loops; all scene data: bodies, operators (input, actor, emitter, hud, fx, music) and Nod rules.

settings.label: Spiral shield (one line)
settings.text: On: the tail is one line wound round the ship. Off: separate rings.

settings.label: Spiral style
settings.text: How the tail is drawn: a soft tail that trails and coils, a stiff tail, or a line grown both ways from the front.

settings.label: Fill speed
settings.text: x1: 8 cubes a turn of shield, x2: 4, x0.5: 16. Spiral off: the rings.

settings.label: Life and tail
settings.text: What a hit on the ship costs: a life, the tail first, or the tail heals the lives.

settings.label: Body hit vs tail hit
settings.text: Separate: a hit on the ship costs a life. Tail first: the tail melts, then the lives; cubes heal first. Tail heals: hurt, the tail draws in and heals it - dim once it is gone. A hit on the ship costs the ratio x a stopped shot.

settings.label: Inertia
settings.text: How loosely the soft tail follows the ship: low firm, high floppy.

settings.label: Shrink per blocked shot
settings.text: How much tail a shot it stops costs.

settings.label: Wave strength
settings.text: How strong the shockwave running along the tail is when a shot hits it.

settings.label: Wave speed
settings.text: How fast that shockwave runs along the tail.

settings.label: Wave fade
settings.text: It trails the ship, then coils round it, and stops shots: each costs that much and sends a shockwave along it.

settings.label: Tail: most turns
settings.text: The most turns of tail the ship can carry.

settings.label: Tail: at the start
settings.text: The tail a game begins with (kept under its most turns).

settings.label: Tail full: points a cube
settings.text: Full, its ring turns gold; every cube taken then is points (green cores: twice, times their size).

settings.label: Beam power
settings.text: The beam's damage, times this.

settings.label: Absorb speed
settings.text: How fast the tail is drawn in while the beam charges (turns a second).

settings.label: Aim the Supernova (it follows the pointer)
settings.text: On: the Supernova follows the pointer. Off: it fires straight at the boss.

settings.label: Parry while charging
settings.text: Hold: the tail is drawn in. Let go: a beam as strong as what you took. 2.5 turns or more: SUPERNOVA.

settings.label: Gun: starting level
settings.text: The gun's level (darts at once) when a game starts.

settings.label: Core: least charge for one
settings.text: The least charge a beam needs to knock off green cores (below: blue cubes, tail only).

settings.label: Core: bigger with power
settings.text: Bigger beams knock off bigger cores: their size and worth grow with the charge, times this.

settings.label: Supernova core: power (and size)
settings.text: A Supernova's cores: their power and size, times this. High: one core can pay for the next Supernova.

settings.label: Supernova: most cores
settings.text: The most cores a Supernova knocks off.

settings.label: Core: tail it gives
settings.text: Tail a green core gives (cubes of tail, times its size).

settings.label: Gun: cores a level
settings.text: Green cores needed for each gun level, times this.

settings.label: Fine tuning: the cubes and the gun
Floor cube: tail it gives
settings.text: Tail a cube picked up from the floor gives.

settings.label: Blue cube: tail it gives
settings.text: Tail a blue cube (a weak beam's) gives.

settings.label: Green core: gun it gives
settings.text: Gun progress a green core gives, times this.

settings.label: Gun: 2 darts at
settings.text: Green cores taken in all for 2 darts.

settings.label: Gun: 3 darts at
settings.text: Green cores taken in all for 3 darts.

settings.label: Gun: 4 darts at
settings.text: Green cores taken in all for 4 darts.

settings.label: Gun: 5 darts at
settings.text: Green cores taken in all (x cores a level); keep each above the one before.

settings.label: Hit: gun levels lost (2: all)
settings.text: Gun levels a hit costs: 0 none, 1 one, 2 all.

settings.label: Gun line round the ship (turquoise, from the nose: the gun's level)
settings.text: A turquoise line round the ship, from its nose: how far the gun is to its next level.

settings.label: Core look (0 cube, 1 gem, 2 diamond)
settings.text: A beam on a boss knocks green cores off it: tail, and the gun grows - 1 dart, then 2, 3, 4, 5 (2, 5, 9, 14 cores). A hit costs levels.

settings.label: Mouth open after a beam
settings.text: How long the ship keeps its mouth open once its beam is gone.

settings.label: Beam hit glow
settings.text: The pieces the beam crosses light up, the bigger the beam the brighter; it breaks the shots it crosses and throws sparks.
Every sound its own volume (0: silent, 1: as made). The bosses' and the game's: the next pages.

settings.label: Beam sound (heard as you pick it)
